استفتوا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْتَوْا (istaftaw) /is.taf.taw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)

# اِسْتَفْتُوا (istaftū) /is.taf.tuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
